title: Director of Operations
text:
Conducting a search on behalf of our client for a
**Director of Operations.**
Our client is a privately held manufacturer of commercial and industrial HVAC equipment with employees. It designs and builds semi-custom, energy-efficient systems for customers in education, hospitality, distribution warehousing, retail, and manufacturing. The company is looking for a Director of Operations to lead day-to-day operations, strengthen how the business runs, and build the systems and teams it needs to keep growing. Full company details will be shared with candidates during the interview process.

**The Role**

Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations will own the performance of the company’s manufacturing and operational functions and turn strategy into execution. Because the company builds semi-custom equipment, this role balances production efficiency with the flexibility to deliver customer-specific configurations. It suits a hands-on leader who can work across the business, from the production floor to the executive team.

Key responsibilities include:

* Oversee daily manufacturing and operations, including production planning, scheduling, and throughput
* Set, track, and improve KPIs for quality, on-time delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction
* Lead, coach, and develop plant managers, supervisors, and key operations staff
* Own the operating budget and drive margin improvement across product lines
* Identify and implement lean processes, standard work, and scalable systems for semi-custom production
* Manage supplier relationships, sourcing, and inventory planning for components and raw materials
* Partner with sales, engineering, and finance on capacity planning, lead times, and new product launches
* Ensure compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and HVAC industry standards

**What the Company Is Looking For**

Required:

* 7+ years of progressive operations or manufacturing leadership, including 3+ years leading managers or multi-site teams
* A record of measurably improving productivity, quality, or margins in a manufacturing environment
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting and P&L ownership
* Experience in HVAC, mechanical equipment, or another engineered-to-order or semi-custom manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred:

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or similar process-improvement certification
* Experience scaling operations through growth, acquisitions, or integration of multiple businesses
* Familiarity with ERP and MRP systems
* Knowledge of commercial HVAC codes, energy-efficiency standards, or indoor air quality requirements
